claim: Neural and hybrid models do not robustly dominate econometric benchmarks.
evidence: Original LSTM and hybrid QLIKE exceed GARCH; proxy safety table reports best neural/hybrid average proxy rank weaker than best econometric rank.
caveat_or_action: Do not say neural or hybrid models are useless.

claim: Log-target neural variants can reduce MAE but underpredict volatility spikes and risk.
evidence: Hybrid-LogTarget-Small has best MAE 1.108165 but QLIKE 2.232917; LSTM-LogTarget has 87 violations at 5 percent and 56 at 1 percent.
caveat_or_action: Use as a metric trade-off and risk-warning claim, not a model-quality endorsement.

evidence: Average raw log-target QLIKE 2.225569 improves to best calibrated 1.146217; best advanced GARCH-family QLIKE is 1.032548.
caveat_or_action: Mention persistent gap and residual spike-timing errors.

claim: Forecast combinations prove robust hybrid superiority.
evidence: Best validation-selected combination test QLIKE 1.113530 trails best GARCH-family models; best test combination is exploratory.
